- Bylaw changes ([last year's bylaws](/Vedtekter.pdf))
  - **Interest groups/BetaLAN leader election**: Until now BetaDev/Sec have chosen their leader internally, and it's proposed to elect these at the general assembly too, like the other committees. That way the interest groups don't disappear when there's little activity, don't get stuck in a group of friends that graduates and leaves the interest group without members, and it gives all Beta members voting influence.
    - Approved with 53 for, 1 against, 1 blank
  - **Leader can be appointed for inactive interest groups**: If an interest group becomes inactive and the leader isn't able to fulfil the position, the board can re-elect a new leader for the interest group.
    - Not brought up.
  - **Appointing an honorary member**: To show that Beta is grateful when people outside the student association get involved, an award can be given once a year to non-members who have meant something to Beta.
    - Was presented as an item, not a bylaw change.
    - The board puts forward two candidates:
      - Arne Wiklund: 30 votes
      - Bendik Egenes Dyrli: 16 votes
    - Other candidates presented during the GA:
      - Halvard Øysæd: 0 votes
  - **PR committee**: To get more people to both take part in and organize things in the student association, the PR role can be expanded into a committee where more people can help promote the student association.
    - Two options:
      - Keep the current solution with 1 PR manager: 30 votes for
      - Change to one of two alternative solutions: 17 votes for
      - 7 blank votes
      - No change approved.
  - **General assembly in the autumn**: To catch more engaged students, it has to happen earlier before other associations get them.
    - Not approved, with everyone against except 1 blank.
  - **Own AI interest group**: A separate interest group for working on AI-related projects.
    - Not approved with 20 for, 15 against, 17 blank (needs 2/3 for)
    - Fixing typos approved: 36 for, 9 against, 1 blank
- Incoming items ([submit a proposal](https://forms.office.com/e/7f26pjvktU))
  - **Price adjustment for company presentations**: Bedkom is raising the price for company presentations, since it hasn't been done in a long time.
    - Currently we charge 12 000kr + VAT for a company presentation
    - Idea to contact the business representative in the municipality (to increase cooperation with companies)
    - Idea of lowering the price was brought up
    - Idea of varying the price for different companies based on size
  - **Promoting/defining BetaDev projects**: Make clear tasks and descriptions of projects so it's easy to join in and work at the meetings.
    - Ask presents the item
      - BetaDev was promoted
  - **Code nights**: Have more nights where you can hang out and code all kinds of things, both study-related and your own projects, where you can collaborate, share and get help.
    - Good interest in holding both code nights and beers and programming
      - Tuesday code lounge in the student lounge
    - The event committee takes it further
  - **Code competitions**: BetaDev could both organize and take part in code competitions.
    - Hackathons
    - CTFs under BetaSec
    - Competitions where you write the most efficient code possible
      - The problem with using ChatGPT was brought up
    - BetaDev takes it further
